nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: Initially, MoO₂-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF were synthesized via a hydrothermal process. We selected high-purity Ni foam as the source material and conductive substrate.
nodes.source_text: Figure 1 depicts the fabrication strategy... Initially, MoO₂-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NP were synthesized via a hydrothermal process.

unit_operations.name: Hydrothermal reaction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: MoO₂-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NP were synthesized via a hydrothermal process

nodes.name: Nitriding treatment
nodes.procedure: Subsequently, the as-synthesized MoO₂-Ni₃S₂/NF was subjected to a nitridation treatment in NH₃ atmosphere, resulting in 3D palm-like Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ arrays on Ni foam (Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF). After nitriding the precursor at 500°C, the Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF electrode was obtained.
nodes.source_text: Subsequently, the as-synthesized MoO₂-Ni₃S₂/NF was subjected to a nitridation treatment in NH₃ atmosphere... After nitriding the precursor at 500°C

nodes.characterization_summary: All diffraction peaks matched well with Mo₅N₆ (PDF# 51-1326), Ni₃S₂ (PDF# 44-1418) and metallic Ni (PDF# 04-0850), confirming successful synthesis of Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF electrode.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The structural characterization of the product was initially conducted by XRD, as displayed in Figure 2a. All diffraction peaks matched well with Mo₅N₆ (PDF# 51-1326), Ni₃S₂ (PDF# 44-1418) and metallic Ni (PDF# 04-0850), strongly confirming the successful synthesis...

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM images reveal palm-like heterogeneous nanostructure retained from precursor with improved crystallinity after nitridation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Furthermore, SEM images in Figure 2b,c reveal that the palm-like heterogeneous nanostructure of Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF has been retained based on the precursor...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows porosity beneficial for exposing active sites; HRTEM confirms interface between Mo₅N₆ and Ni₃S₂ with lattice fringes of 0.204 nm (202) plane of Ni₃S₂, 0.244 nm (110) and 0.183 nm (114) planes of Mo₅N₆.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image in Figure 2d reveals that Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs possesses porosity... The high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image (Figure 2e) further confirms the formation of an interface... lattice fringes of 0.204, 0.244, and 0.183 nm...

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED demonstrates polycrystalline properties of Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The selected area electron diffraction pattern (SAED) in Figure 2g demonstrates that Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF possesses polycrystalline properties.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM and elemental mappings show homogeneous distribution of Mo, N, Ni, and S throughout the electrode.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to HAADF-STEM and the corresponding elemental mappings (Figure 2h), the elements of Mo, N, Ni, and S are homogeneously distributed throughout the entire Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF electrode.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mo 3d shows peaks at 228.7, 231.9 eV (Mo-N), 229.4, 232.7, 235.3 eV (Mo⁴⁺, Mo⁶⁺); N 1s at 397.3 eV; Ni 2p at 855.4, 873.0 eV with satellites at 861.6, 879.5 eV and metallic Ni at 853.0 eV; S 2p at 162.7, 161.5 eV (metal-S) and 168.0 eV (oxidized S). Shifts indicate electron transfer from Ni₃S₂ to Mo₅N₆.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution XPS spectrum of Mo 3d for Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF (Figure 3a) can be deconvoluted into five peaks... In comparison to pristine Mo₅N₆ and Ni₃S₂/NF, the Mo 3d spectrum... exhibits a shift toward a higher binding energy...

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface area of 30.5 m²/g for Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF, larger than precursor MoO₂-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF (27.5 m²/g) and bare NF (6.7 m²/g).
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure S7 (Supporting Information) shows the nitrogen adsorption-desorption isotherms of Mo5N6-Ni3S2 HNPs/NF, MoO2-Ni3S2 HNPs/NF, Ni3S2/NF, Mo5N6/NF, and NF, and their specific surface areas were calculated to be 30.5, 27.5, 26.1, 15.8 and 6.7 m² g⁻¹.

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance Cdl = 35 mF/cm², corresponding to ECSA = 583 cm².
nodes.evidence_snippet: the Cdl values of Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF... are calculated to be 35, 22, 0.7, 1.0 and 0.4 mF cm⁻², corresponding to the ECSA values of 583, 366, 11.6, 16.6 and 6.66 cm² respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: Charge transfer resistance Rct ≈ 2.5 Ω, smallest among compared catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Rct values for Mo₅N₆-Ni₃S₂ HNPs/NF... were determined to be ≈2.5, 3.5, 4.0, 9.7, and 23.8 Ω respectively.
